# Chrono24

> > Chrono24 is the world's leading marketplace for luxury watches, connecting buyers and sellers with comprehensive buyer protection, escrow services, and market data tools.

Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chrono24 serves as a trusted platform for luxury watch trading, offering seller tools, listing optimization, personalized offers, and compliance guidance including EPR legislation for batteries and EEE. The platform features the Chrono24 Magazine, Chronopulse analytics, and partnerships with publications like GQ and Luxury Daily.

## Key Topics

- Buyer Protection
- Escrow Service
- Luxury Watch Marketplace
- Listing Optimization
- Seller Partners
- Personalized Offers
- EPR Compliance (BATT & EEE)
- Chronopulse Market Data
- Certified Watches
- Watch Selling Tools
- Phishing Security
- Chrono24 Magazine
- Legal Requirements
- Career Opportunities
- Press & News
